meta.scope: Mexico batch 12 — Oaxaca (third-poorest state, 51.6% multidimensional poverty). Completes the poor-state contrast set (Chiapas, Guerrero, Oaxaca) and the Mexico profile before moving to the next country. Includes State → Metro (Zona Metropolitana de Oaxaca) → Key municipalities → Local institute / judiciary / national disaggregations.
meta.personal_note: Added at user request — previously studied while learning to make Oaxaca Pozole.

candidates.title: Oaxaca (entidad federativa) — core statistical identity
candidates.description: Third-poorest state by multidimensional poverty (51.6% in 2024) and extreme poverty (16.3%). Large indigenous population, high linguistic diversity, and predominantly rural. Statistical capacity exists but is thinner than northern/central states and more dependent on national INEGI programmes.
candidates.notes: Third in the poverty ranking after Chiapas (66.0%) and Guerrero (58.1%). Notable improvement 2022–2024 (−6.8 percentage points), yet still more than 20 points above the national average (29.6%). Tests the same hierarchy under high poverty and indigenous-majority conditions. Completes the southern poverty contrast set.

candidates.title: Zona Metropolitana de Oaxaca (ZMO) — metropolitan / capital statistical profile
candidates.description: Metropolitan area formed by Oaxaca de Juárez and approximately 24–26 surrounding municipalities. Population ~745 000 (2020). Functions as the limited ‘metro’ node for the state. Data almost entirely from national programmes with thinner independent local statistical production.
referenced_by: Economic and tourism reporting for the Valley of Oaxaca
candidates.notes: In a high-poverty state the metro node is essentially the capital valley. Local statistical packaging is thinner than IIEG Jalisco or IPDP CDMX. Most usable series remain national cuts to municipality or metro.

candidates.title: Oaxaca de Juárez — capital municipal profile
candidates.publisher: INEGI / Ayuntamiento de Oaxaca de Juárez
candidates.description: Capital municipality of Oaxaca (~271 000 inhabitants in 2020). Principal urban centre and the core of the Zona Metropolitana de Oaxaca. Statistical presence is predominantly national programmes (census, ENOE, ENIGH, CNGMD, economic census) with limited independent local statistical production.
referenced_by: Metropolitan delineations and Valley of Oaxaca economic reporting
candidates.notes: Capital node in a high-poverty, high-indigenous state. Independent local statistical capacity is thinner than in Zapopan or CDMX alcaldías. Most numbers remain national cuts. Clear homogeneity contrast.

candidates.title: Poder Judicial / Fiscalía del Estado de Oaxaca — statistical presence
candidates.publisher: Poder Judicial del Estado de Oaxaca / Fiscalía General del Estado de Oaxaca
candidates.description: State justice and prosecution institutions. Data appear mainly through national CNIJE / CNPJE rather than rich independent local yearbooks.
candidates.notes: Homogeneity test: in a high-poverty state the local judicial statistical production is thinner than CDMX’s Anuario or even Jalisco’s local reporting. Most usable numbers come from the national INEGI justice censuses.

candidates.title: Oaxaca poverty and social-lag profile (INEGI / Bienestar compilations)
candidates.publisher: INEGI / Secretaría de Bienestar / state sources
candidates.description: State-level poverty and social-lag picture. 51.6% multidimensional poverty and 16.3% extreme poverty in 2024. Largely derived from INEGI ENIGH and the official multidimensional methodology rather than independent primary state surveys.
referenced_by: Informe Anual sobre la Situación de Pobreza y Rezago Social
candidates.notes: Third-poorest state. Notable improvement 2022–2024 (−6.8 pp) yet still far above the national average. Local statistical products are frequently compilations of INEGI data. Completes the southern poverty contrast set (Chiapas 66%, Guerrero 58.1%, Oaxaca 51.6%).

proposed_edges.basis: Oaxaca de Juárez is the capital municipality and core of the ZMO / Oaxaca entity.
Zona Metropolitana de Oaxaca is the principal urban aggregation within the state.
State poverty figures are the entity-level cut of the national multidimensional poverty measurement based on ENIGH.
